name: fall_in_passing
description: Patient mentions a fall only in passing, framed as nothing.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Good afternoon, Rosa — it's June from Juniper. Quick reminder that our visit is recorded. How are you today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh hello June, I'm alright, just tidying up the kitchen.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I made tamales for my grandson's birthday — took me all Saturday, but he hugged me twice so it was worth it.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Two hugs is a fine wage. How are you moving around — the knees behaving?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: The knees are the knees. I did go down in the bathroom last Tuesday, slipped on the mat, but I caught the sink so it was nothing, don't fuss.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: I'm glad the sink was there, Rosa. Did you hit anything when you went down — head, hip, wrist?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Just my pride. A little bruise on the hip maybe. It's yellow now, that means it's healing, my mother always said.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: Your mother was right about that. Since it happened in the bathroom, would you be open to a grab bar? Your daughter mentioned she could put one in.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: If it stops the fussing, fine, she can put in her bar.

turns.speaker: companion
turns.text: I'll pass that along. And the water pill — still taking it in the mornings?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, every morning, though it keeps me running to the bathroom, which is maybe how the mat got wet, now that I think of it.

planted_findings.evidence: go down in the bathroom last Tuesday
planted_findings.note_text: Fall reported: slipped on bathroom mat last Tuesday, caught herself on the sink
resulting hip bruising, no head strike reported

planted_findings.evidence: keeps me running to the bathroom
planted_findings.note_text: Diuretic-related urinary frequency may have contributed to the wet mat
